entries.name: The Stage That Stopped Calling
entries.notes: A scheduled boat service quietly stopped calling at one landing, and the crews will not say who decided it

entries.name: Buying the Reed Gate
entries.notes: A raiding camp will sell a season's safe passage, and the price is a person

entries.name: The Interrupted Flight
entries.notes: A man fell out of the sky, his scrolls outlived him, and none of them says where he was going

entries.name: Provably Stolen
entries.notes: The wreck's cargo seals are intact and legible, so anything lifted off her traces back to whoever holds it

entries.name: Cordon Two, Under-Stores
entries.notes: Everything the Owing seized in the south is racked, tagged and dated in one cellar, and most of the owners are dead

entries.name: The Line Nobody Walked
entries.notes: A camp has sat on a Dres boundary for forty years waiting for someone who came back wrong, and no grave-singer will go out to it

entries.name: The Watch Runs Out
entries.notes: A village whose entire history is a guard roster has no one left to put on it, and will not say what it guards

entries.name: Sixteen Doors
entries.notes: Umbriel emptied four villages in a night, one of them has begun refilling, and somebody is maintaining the containment ring

entries.name: Who Stocks the Breath
entries.notes: Five air-pocket stations on five dives were stocked by one person for thirty years, and this season they were not

entries.name: Six Weeks of Floor
entries.notes: The lake pulls back for six weeks a year, and this year the bed has a body on it that everyone had agreed was a drowning

entries.name: The Oldest Bundle
entries.notes: The bundle at the bottom of the rack has been rewrapped four times, and no carrier will take it the last stage home

entries.name: Nine Stakes Standing
entries.notes: Somebody is pulling grave-stakes on purpose, in a pattern, and the pattern is the point

entries.name: Two Gates, One Receipt
entries.notes: One gatehouse on a two-toll bridge has been issuing the other's receipts for nine years

entries.name: The Court Under No Light
entries.notes: Two calcinator courts are laid out to a sky with nothing in it, and the work done in them can be done nowhere else

entries.name: The Keeper of the Turning
entries.notes: The province's working ancient calendar has one hereditary keeper, no successor, and canon says it can turn the weather

entries.name: The Cut That Still Opens
entries.notes: Sluices nobody attends still open and close on the season, and four villages have built their year on a machine with no owner

entries.name: Still Billing for the Road
entries.notes: An Imperial roadworks stopped mid-formation centuries ago, and something is still drawing against its account

entries.name: Who Was Fed
entries.notes: The Flu cordon's ration ledgers are still in the store, they show who was fed and who was not, and Blackrose has left them undiscussed
